full_name: Sandra Kogut | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Arts Radcliffe-Film Study Center Fellow GloboNews Channel (Brazil)
bio: Sandra Kogut is a filmmaker most recently known for Campo Grande (2015) and Three Summers (2019). At Radcliffe, she is creating a large-scale archive of the digital present by exploring how ordinary people effectively create a representation of themselves through their online activities; the archive will then serve as the basis of a documentary film.
